title: tune-nccl-overlap-scheduling-and-collectives-for-tensor-parallel
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Motivation: Tensor-parallel workloads were showing suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and local kernel execution on multi-GPU nodes, causing higher p90 latency and lower amortized throughput for medium-length sequences. This PR introduces scheduling refinements and collective orchestration to increase commute/overlap, adds an async-collectives mode for select ops, and stabilizes stream priorities to reduce kernel stalls. Changes: 1) Introduce NcclCollectiveScheduler that assigns collectives to dedicated comm streams with tunable priorities and enqueues dependent kernel work on compute streams with explicit events to maximize overlap. 2) Add async collectives path for AllReduce/AllGather used in tensor-parallel sharded linear layers; fallback to sync collectives when profiling indicates regressions. 3) Adjust default stream priorities and introduce conservative backoff for kernel launch throttling to avoid head-of-line blocking. 4) Add kernel batching hints from continuous_batcher to group local compute kernels adjacent to pending collectives. 5) KV cache alignment: add lightweight synchronization to allow prefix-KV reads to proceed while remote collectives are in-flight. 6) Perf harness changes and docs. Testing: unit tests for scheduler logic, integration perf runs on 8xA100 node, stress tests for failover to sync collectives. Results: internal perf runs show ~22% throughput improvement (token/s) for TP=8 sharded model on 2048 token synthetic load, and ~12% p90 latency reduction on realistic chat traces; memory overhead minimal (+<1%). Rollout plan: gated feature flag runtime.enable_async_tp_collectives disabled by default; staged rollout to dedicated clusters then hosted. Related: ENG-8721 linearization work, ENG-8799 batching improvements. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration perf [x] docs updated [x] feature flag [x] canary plan

review_comments: Jason Liu: Nice clean abstraction for scheduling. Two high-level asks: add a small perf test that toggles the feature flag, and make the priority thresholds configurable via env vars. Author reply: added perf harness scripts and exposed env override for priority mapping.

Priya Nair: Observed potential double-sync on error path in kv_cache_manager; please add a test for early abort path. Author reply: fixed race in stream event handling and added unit test that simulates aborted collectives.

Marco D'Souza: Can we get more details on fallback heuristics (when async->sync)? Suggested adding a telemetry counter. Author reply: added runtime.telemetry.collective_fallback counter and emitted events in both paths.

release_notes: Improve multi-GPU tensor-parallel performance by tuning NCCL collectives and stream scheduling. Adds optional async collectives path (runtime.enable_async_tp_collectives) with fallback heuristics. Expect ~20% throughput uplift on TP=8 workloads and lower p90 latency for medium-length sequences.
